text:
clara: Proposal: run a 10-day "cohort blitz" DP (3d onboarding + 7d active) to get fast, comparable signal.
ben: Shorter window could improve focus - agree. How many partners?
clara: Target 5-7, at least one integration pilot. Emphasis on rapid, testable asks.
meera: Recruitment screener (tiny):
```
1) workload (chat/generate/embeddings)
2) est tokens/day (range)
3) willingness to share redacted traces (Y/N)
4) can run 1 quick integration test pre-cohort? (Y/N)
```
sam: Perks: priority triage, 1:1 onboarding, and a short technical healthcheck. We'll publish clear SLA expectations in the invite.
clara: Success criteria idea:
- 5 partners meeting commit (>=1 onboarding + 2 live touchpoints + weekly async)
- 1 integration pilot with sustained traffic (>3k tokens/day for 48h)
- >=4 actionable GH issues per cohort with repro or spec proposals
- no P0 regressions on latency/cost
meera: Add feedback quality: >=3 spec proposals or reproducible bugs.
clara: Ops: can we promise reserved capacity?
ops-bot: Reserved pool possible but requires 7d lead time; default = hosted with spike protection routing.
sam: We'll offer a small reserved buffer for confirmed integrators. Clara, I'll draft invite copy tomorrow.
nina-legal: On traces, use wording: "share redacted request/response traces for debugging; we will redact and store per DPA terms". I can post exact clause by EOD.
meera: Feedback loop: daily async pulse card + two short live clinics during the 7d active window. Capture prompts + golden outputs for eval harness.
clara: Owners: sam (ops & invites), meera (prompt sets & Notion pulse), ben (recruiting), nina-legal (contracts).
sam: I'll create #dp-cohort-blitz channel and a GH repo for artifacts after invite draft.
meera: Pairing with runtime for auto-eval Monday 11am.
clara: Timeline: recruit 1 week, cohort 10 days, 3 days wrap = ~3 weeks total. Pilot start target in 3 weeks.
ben: Gate to wider preview: >=75% actionables triaged/fixed or scheduled, no P1/P0 regressions, and at least one validated integrator pilot.
clara: Thanks all. Small optional note: include a "light" participation flag for partners who only want async feedback to keep funnel open.
sam: noted. will include in screener. :thumbsup:
